text:
Ana (CS): Heads-up: Crestline questionnaire landed (SOC2 + DPA follow-up). Raising because renewal check next quarter and they flagged KMS / residency. Threading owners — @Priya (Security) and @Mike (Onboard).
Priya (Security): On it — can you drop the form link + their latest dataflow? I'll triage for BYOK / edge-subprocessor asks.
Ana (CS): Link: <https://redwood.docs/crestline-q2> (internal copy). Dataflow diagram is in the doc. Quick summary: embeddings in hosted, PII pseudonymization by preprocessor, EU residency requested for some tenants.
Mike (Onboard): Got it. Will confirm whether they need Private deployment or Dedicated. If Private, we'll need SOC2 scope mapping + KMS proof (attestation).
Sam (AE): FYI: customer health is okay but renewal risk if we can't show residency SLA. CS noted possible budget reduction if costs spike.
Priya (Security): Checklist I'll run: SOC2 evidence present? (yes), KMS BYOK? (no), Subprocessor list up-to-date? (partial). I can draft answers, need product confirmation on embeddings storage TTL.
Ana (CS): Product question: what's current embeddings retention default for hosted? @Mike (Onboard) do you have the config path? DeployBot can show config snapshot.
DeployBot: ```
config-snapshot:
embeddings.retention.default = 30d
residency.tags = [global, us-east, eu-west]
```
Mike (Onboard): We can set a project-specific override to 90d and enable eu-west residency for their tenant. Need CS sign-off and a change request.
Ana (CS): Customer prefers 365d for audit reasons — is that a hard blocker?
Mike (Onboard): Technically possible but costly on hosted; recommend Dedicated or Private for sustained 365d retention. I'll outline cost delta and a migration plan.
Priya (Security): I'll prepare DPA answers: note BYOK not available in hosted; offer roadmap + timeline if they want Private. Also preparing SOC2 mapping doc for legal.
Sam (AE): I'll push the 'roadmap offer' in the renewal call next week, flag the tradeoffs. Can someone draft a short customer-facing statement?
Ana (CS): I'll draft. Capture: what we can do now (residency tag + retention override limited), what requires Dedicated/Private (BYOK, long-term retention at scale), timelines, and evidence we can provide. Will post draft by EOD.
Priya (Security): Adding: ask SRE for audit logs retention proof; will loop @SRE oncall after draft.
Mike (Onboard): Also propose a short enablement session on dataflow and ops controls with their security team — 30 min demo + handoff docs.
Ana (CS): :thumbsup: thanks all — next steps: Priya to draft legal answers, Mike to scope infra change + cost delta, Ana to send customer-facing note by EOD, Sam to prep renewal talking points. Ping here when drafts ready.
DeployBot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up meeting created 2026-03-26 15:00 UTC — invite sent to internal owners.
